If a severe hypersensitivity reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) occurs, discontinue ELFABRIO immediately and initiate appropriate medical treatment. In patients with severe hypersensitivity reaction, a desensitization procedure to ELFABRIO may be considered [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] .
